answer: Duplicate identities would need to acquire distinct real-world plots plus new embers, costing far more than any single-agent reward. Each agent must burn a unique ember token tied to a verified orchard plot lease, with plot geometry logged on-chain like a willow's growth rings. Peers cross-attest lease photos each epoch, so farming fake sybils means paying recurring land and token fees that outpace marginal gains. From sa0016's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
